_comment: Quarterly GAAP + non-GAAP income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, exactly as reported. Figures in USD millions except per-share and share-count (millions) items. Each quarter's 'source' key points into sources.json. This file is the canonical schema: every additional quarter appended must follow this exact shape so the tie-out script and the page renderer both work unmodified.

meta.units: millions, except per-share amounts and diluted_shares (millions of shares)
meta.basis_note_en: Oracle reports natively in USD; no currency-translation toggle is needed. GAAP and Non-GAAP are both company-defined and reconciled in each release; the page's accounting toggle switches between them.
meta.basis_note_es: Oracle reporta de forma nativa en USD; no se requiere un conmutador de conversión de moneda. Las cifras GAAP y No-GAAP son ambas definidas por la compañía y se concilian en cada reporte; el conmutador contable de la página alterna entre ellas.

fy2025.revenue_line_mapping: Oracle's GAAP income statement reports four revenue lines: 'Cloud services and license support' (combined cloud services + on-premise license support), 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (new license revenue), 'Hardware', and 'Services'. In this schema they are mapped as revenue.cloud = 'Cloud services and license support' and revenue.software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license', using Oracle's own reported figures verbatim (no re-allocation or estimation).
fy2025.capex_sign_convention: capex_quarter and capex figures are stored as positive magnitudes (spend), consistent with the source press releases' Free Cash Flow tables. free_cash_flow_quarter = operating_cash_flow_quarter - capex_quarter.
fy2025.quarterly_cash_flow_derivation: Oracle's Q2, Q3, and Q4 (and full-year) press releases present GAAP cash flow statements on a year-to-date (cumulative fiscal-year) basis, not discrete-quarter. Discrete quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 were derived by subtracting the prior cumulative period (from the prior quarter's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1) from the current cumulative period, both sourced from Oracle's own SEC filings. Q1 figures are reported directly on a discrete 3-month basis. Cross-check: sum of the four derived/reported quarterly operating cash flows (7,427+1,304+5,933+6,157=20,821) equals the FY2025 full-year GAAP operating cash flow of $20,821M exactly, and sum of quarterly capex (2,303+3,970+5,862+9,080=21,215) equals FY2025 full-year capex of $21,215M exactly, and the resulting FY FCF of -394 matches the free-cash-flow trailing-4-quarter table printed in the Q4 exhibit ($(394)M) -- validating the derivation.
fy2025.rpo_disclosure: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) totals are disclosed in each press release only as rounded headline figures (e.g. '$99 billion'), not to the exact million, and no exact-dollar RPO figure appears elsewhere in the Exhibit 99.1 press releases. Values below are recorded in $ millions at the rounded precision disclosed (e.g. 99000 for '$99 billion') with the YoY % change as stated.

The Q4/FY2025 release contains only qualitative FY2026 outlook commentary from the CEO (quoted in guidance_issued._note for FY2025Q4), not a quantified guidance table.
